args.title: Fix password reset email links to use PUBLIC_URL instead of localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently uses a hardcoded localhost URL (`http://localhost:3000`) as the fallback when `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes the reset link to point to localhost, which is unusable for users outside the development environment. The fix is to ensure the email uses the correct `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable, which should be configured to the production domain. This aligns with the existing pattern in the codebase and resolves the issue where users receive non-functional reset links.
